newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran diplomats held and released in Dushanbe.
newsitem.headline: Iran diplomats held and released in Dushanbe.

text.p: Two Iranian diplomats were held at gunpoint outside Iran's embassy in Dushanbe on Saturday but were released later, the Iranian official news agency IRNA reported on Monday.
"The two diplomats were held for about an hour before they were released in a southern district of Dushanbe," IRNA quoted Iran's ambassador to Tajikistan, Rasoul Moussavi, as saying.

Tajikistan has just emerged from a four-year civil war in which the government faced opposition Islamist guerrillas. But clashes involving warlords nominally loyal to the government are still going on.
